item.title: Microsoft 365 Self Service Purchase Licenses
item.author: Andreas Dieckmann
item.description:
Since about the end of 2019, Microsoft has introduced self service purchase licenses for Microsoft 365. With this new feature, end users in an Office 365 tenant can buy licenses for some products themselves. As of 2020-12-01, the following products are available:

  • Power Apps per user
  • Power Automate per user
  • Power Automate RPA
  • Power BI Pro
  • Power BI Premium (standalone)
  • Project Plan 1
  • Project Plan 3
  • Visio Plan 1
  • Visio Plan 2

Explanation video

item.title: Office 365 Trial Licenses
item.author: Andreas Dieckmann
item.description: You can register for a free Office 365/Microsoft 365 Tenant to try it out. Or you can add trial licenses to your existing tenant. You’ll get a 30 day trial phase. The trial contains 25 user licenses. After the expiration of the trial phase, you can delete the tenant or extend the trial. Alternatively you can purchase licenses to continue to use the services.
